theory.label: Novak & Cañas, "The Theory Underlying Concept Maps"

The notation is the established one from system dynamics — polarity on the link, R/B on the loop, strokes across a delayed arrow. What ADP adds is the check: a loop is reinforcing on an even count of negative links and balancing on an odd one, so a stated label is verifiable, and a disagreement is reported rather than corrected. Cycles are enumerated with Johnson’s elementary cycles algorithm, bounded. The self-organizing layout adopts Meyer’s method with every source of randomness replaced by a function of the document and the iteration index
